% Measured frame, without changing the painted path; this is not a gallery input.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\makeatletter
\newcommand{\reportbox}[1]{\typeout{BOUNDS #1: \the\pgf@picminy, \the\pgf@picmaxy}}
\begin{document}
\foreach \angle in {45,-45,20,-120}{%
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \draw (0,0) ellipse[x radius=7mm,y radius=2mm,rotate=\angle];
    \reportbox{native \angle}
  \end{tikzpicture}%
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \let\originalcurve\pgf@nlt@curveto
    \def\pgf@nlt@curveto{\relax\originalcurve}
    \draw (0,0) ellipse[x radius=7mm,y radius=2mm,rotate=\angle];
    \reportbox{terminated assignment \angle}
  \end{tikzpicture}\par}
\end{document}
